environment.note: Tranche 22 - pitch/repitch pitch-data family. Fixtures /tmp/probe22a (harmonic 220 Hz 'vow', wobbling 261 Hz 'wob', 220->440 glide, 330 Hz 'mid', white noise; pvoc anal 1 defaults). Binary pitch data (.frq) format pinned: RIFF/WAVE FLOAT mono at the analysis window rate (344), LIST 'is a pitch file' property + DATE, one float32 Hz per window, markers -1 (unpitched, -z only) / -2 (silence); .trn = same container with 'is a transpos file'. SCHEMA GAP DRIVES THE TRANCHE: output_format has no binary pitch-data member, so every binary pitch/transposition PRODUCER is entry-blocked (integrator candidate: add .frq/.trn to DATA_OUTPUT_FORMATS); consumers work today via aux_file. Second engine gap pinned: validate_params rejects caller-supplied plain strings for non-aux params (grain reorder 'code' shares this wall) - getpitch side filenames are therefore curated fixed defaults. Full workflow chains verified END-TO-END through process_impl (transcript section 10): (A) all-curated pitch-contour transfer getpitch 1 + getpitch 2 -> combineb 1 -> transposef 3 with abs-mode breakpoints (mean tracked-pitch delta 5.1 Hz against the target contour); (B) getpitch 1 -> execute() quantise 2 -> transposef 4 (wobble snapped to C-major plateaus). Every curated entry engine-run at least once.
